Gina Hinojosa

Democratic candidate for Governor, Texas · Challenger

State representative; civil rights attorney

Represents Austin's House District 49 since 2017. Won the March 3 Democratic primary with about 58.5% of the vote.

Where Hinojosa stands

Property taxes
Has said she wants to eliminate homeowners' property taxes; opposes a state income tax.
Schools
Wants to end the education savings account program, increase public school funding, and change testing and accountability rules.
Cost of living
Proposes a $1,500 payment to Texas families from the state's Rainy Day Fund.
Data centers
Has criticized data center tax breaks and cited electricity bills as a household cost concern.
